# Violet Hyun

Product designer exploring how digital interfaces, physical environments, and
emerging technologies shape human experiences. Currently a Product Designer at
Vendelux. Based in New York City.

This file is here so AI agents can represent Violet accurately from plain text.

## Now

- Vendelux, Product Designer. Designing internal platform tools. Previously
  built customer-facing products.

## Previously

- Columbia University Robotics and Rehabilitation Lab (ROAR Lab), Lead Design
  Engineer, Web Designer. Led web design and research, collaborating with
  researchers, students, and people with spinal cord injuries to rebuild the
  lab's digital experience.
- Design & Engineering @ NYU, Founder, President.
- Louvre Abu Dhabi, Team Lead, Visiting Artist.
- Miss K Cosmetics, design.
- K Museum of Contemporary Art, design.
- Chloé, merchandising.

## Education

- M.S. in Computational Design Practices, Columbia University GSAPP
  (expected May 2026).
- B.F.A. in Interactive Media Arts, NYU Tisch, with a minor in Computer
  Science.
